name: app-design-process-gantt-with-inline-icon-headline-and-hashtag-strip
title: Design Process Gantt with Inline Icon Headline
whatItIs: A tall white page with a headline whose words alternate grey and black with small app icons inline, a Design Process pill, a Gantt chart of six capsules stepping down across eight weeks, a strip of hashtag pills, a statement with an app icon and four overlapping outlined circles with tinted fills holding stats (50K+ users, $42 savings, 74/100, $184.40).
whatItMeans: Overlapping tinted circles make numbers feel like bubbles, and the inline icons make a headline part illustration.
techniques: Inline app icons inside a headline
Overlapping outlined circles filled with soft gradients
Huge faint logo shape behind the chart

vocabulary.definition: A row of pills listing tags.
An icon set within a line of text.
